Accueil.surtitre: Casa Noppalu, Guest House in Senegal
Accueil.titre: Your pied-à-terre with a pool in Saly
Accueil.intro: In Saly, in the residential neighborhood of Niakhnakhal, Casa Noppalu welcomes you in a simple and comfortable setting, far from large hotel complexes. Our three independent, air-conditioned studios, equipped with a kitchenette and Wi-Fi, offer you the freedom to organize your days at your own pace, while enjoying the pool, garden, and beach, accessible in a ten-minute walk.
